summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (MTEK), furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) attaching a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing a preliminary 2026 gross revenue forecast exceeding $5,000,000, versus roughly $1,341,000 in 2025, an increase of at least 272%. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The release cites existing and anticipated 2026 orders, is unaudited and forward-looking, and is incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. Watch for order backlog confirmation and 2027 guidance.
